title: David Saves Keila and Flees
description: David asks the Lord and goes to Keila to defeat the Philistines and save the city from plunder. When Saul learns that David is there, he plans to besiege the city. David consults the Lord through the ephod that the priest Abjathar has with him, and is told that the inhabitants will hand him over. Therefore, he flees from Keila with his about six hundred men, and Saul gives up pursuing him there.
